from pocket_coffea.workflows.base_processor import BaseProcessor
import awkward as ak

class DimuonProcessor(BaseProcessor):
    def object_preselection(self, events):
        muons = events.Muon
        events["MuonGood"] = muons[(muons.pt > 15) & (abs(muons.eta) < 2.4)]
        return events
    
    def object_counting(self, events):
        events["nMuonGood"] = ak.num(events.MuonGood)
        return events
